text:
alex: Heads-up: planning to change audit_event payload — remove `actor_ip`, add `actor_location` (country), `client_sdk`, and `event_flags`. Need versioning + customer validation path. cc @maria @security-oncall
maria: Why drop actor_ip?
alex: Legal requested data minimization for EU customers; we should stop storing raw IPs. We'll keep `hashed_ip` for correlation.
jason: Migration strategy idea: keep v1/v2 parallel, add top-level `schema_version`. Consumers can opt into v2.
kevin: We should publish client adapters (Node/Python) and a validator CLI so partners can test before switching.
security-oncall: RBAC shouldn't change, but confirm KMS wrapping for `actor_id` stays decryptable across rotations. KMS key rotation might break older events if not handled.
deploy-bot: feature-flag `audit.v2` created in staging for canary tests :white_check_mark:
maria: Backfill question — should we backfill `event_flags` for last 90 days? Backfills are risky, I'd prefer nullable and leave empty for old events.
kevin: Suggest adding `X-Audit-Schema-Version` header on webhooks to make it easier for webhook consumers to route/parse.
jason: I'll draft a JSON schema and validator harness. Example snippet to validate minimal v2 payload:
```json
{"schema_version":"2","required":["event_type","timestamp","actor_id"]}
```
alex: Timeline proposal: week1 - feature flag + internal canary; week2 - adapters + docs; week3 - EU rollout + partner invite; week4 - wider rollout with 30d dual-delivery mode.
security-oncall: Add monitoring: alert on spike in 4xx/5xx from webhook endpoints, and create an SLI for event compatibility regressions.
maria: Customer comms draft: provide migration guide, sample payloads, and a `migration-mode` where they can receive v1+v2 in parallel for 30 days.
alex: Action items: @kevin build adapters + validator, @jason write migration doc + JSON schema, @maria draft customer comms, @security-oncall confirm KMS/rotation impact. I'll sync with legal on IP minimization.
kevin: Got it — starting PR today.
incident-bot: created runbook `audit-schema-rollout-failures` in ops for webhook compatibility incidents.
alex: Quick note — include an opt-out flag per-account during initial rollout so customers can delay v2 if they have strict parsing logic.
